description:
Shown in the suburb report as the 'Voting (winning party)' map layer in the
Demographics section.

Projected winning party, runner-up and margin for every mesh block in the suburb at April 2026 federal polling — a projection,
not an actual vote. The suburb-wide profile is ``/demographics/voting``.
Values only; polygons come from ``/shapes/mesh-blocks``.

**Price: 20¢ per call.**
name: suburbs_demographics_voting_map
title: Voting — winning party (by suburb)
